arxiv-1408-6422.creator: Hehu Xie, Manting Xie
arxiv-1408-6422.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Hehu Xie, Manting Xie. A multigrid method is proposed to compute the ground state solution of Bose-Einstein condensations by the finite element method based on the multilevel correction for eigenvalue problems and the multigrid method for linear boundary value problems.

arxiv-2011-05716.title: Filtered Manifold Alignment
arxiv-2011-05716.creator: Stefan Dernbach, Don Towsley
arxiv-2011-05716.description: Abstract Domain adaptation is an essential task in transfer learning to leverage data in one domain to bolster learning in another domain. In this paper, we present a new semi-supervised manifold alignment technique based on a two-step approach of projecting and filtering the source and target domains to low dimensional spaces followed by joining the two spaces.

arxiv-2103-08889.title: Quick Learning Mechanism with Cross-Domain Adaptation for Intelligent Fault Diagnosis
arxiv-2103-08889.creator: Arun K. Sharma, Nishchal K. Verma
arxiv-2103-08889.description: Abstract The fault diagnostic model trained for a laboratory case machine fails to perform well on the industrial machines running under variable operating conditions. For every new operating condition of such machines, a new diagnostic model has to be trained which is a time-consuming and uneconomical process.

arxiv-2109-13511.title: Dynamical Switching of Magnetic Topology in Microwave-Driven Itinerant Magnet
arxiv-2109-13511.creator: Rintaro Eto, Masahito Mochizuki
arxiv-2109-13511.description: Abstract We theoretically demonstrate microwave-induced dynamical switching of magnetic topology in centrosymmetric itinerant magnets by taking the Kondo-lattice model on a triangular lattice, which is known to exhibit two types of skyrmion lattices with different magnetic topological charges of | N sk | |N_{\rm sk}| =1 and | N sk | |N_{\rm sk}| =2.

arxiv-2302-00208.creator: J. P. Lees, V. Poireau, V. Tisserand, E. Grauges, A. Palano, G. Eigen, D. N. Brown, Yu. G. Kolomensky, M. Fritsch, H. Koch, R. Cheaib, C. Hearty, T. S. Mattison, J. A. arxiv-2302-00208.description: Abstract A new mechanism has been proposed to simultaneously explain the presence of dark matter and the matter-antimatter asymmetry in the universe. This scenario predicts exotic B B meson decays into a baryon and a dark sector anti-baryon ( ψ D \psi_{D} ) with branching fractions accessible at B B factories.

arxiv-2307-13397.title: Scoring Cycling Environments Perceived Safety using Pairwise Image Comparisons
arxiv-2307-13397.creator: Miguel Costa, Manuel Marques, Felix Wilhelm Siebert, and Carlos Lima Azevedo, Filipe Moura
arxiv-2307-13397.description: Abstract Today, many cities seek to transition to more sustainable transportation systems. Cycling is critical in this transition for shorter trips, including first-and-last-mile links to transit. Yet, if individuals perceive cycling as unsafe, they will not cycle and choose other transportation modes.

arxiv-2407-14221.title: Tunneling current and current correlations for anyonic quasiparticles of ν = 1 / 2 \nu=1/2 chiral Luttinger liquid in multi-edge geometries
arxiv-2407-14221.creator: Gu Zhang, Domenico Giuliano, Igor V. Gornyi, Gabriele Campagnano
arxiv-2407-14221.description: Abstract We consider anyonic quasiparticles with charge e / 2 e/2 described by the ν = 1 / 2 \nu=1/2 chiral Luttinger liquid, which collide in a Hong–Ou–Mandel-like interferometer. These colliding anyonic channels can be formally viewed as hosting Laughlin-like fractional ν = 1 / 2 \nu=1/2 quasiparticles.

arxiv-2408-02333.title: Liquid drop with capillarity and rotating traveling waves
arxiv-2408-02333.creator: Pietro Baldi, Vesa Julin, Domenico Angelo La Manna
arxiv-2408-02333.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pietro Baldi, Vesa Julin, Domenico Angelo La Manna. We consider the free boundary problem for a 3-dimensional, incompressible, irrotational liquid drop of nearly spherical shape with capillarity. arxiv-2505-22692.title: Genomic-Informed Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Spatiotemporal Avian Influenza Outbreak Forecasting
arxiv-2505-22692.creator: Jing Du, Haley Stone, Yang Yang, Ashna Desai, Hao Xue, Andreas Züfle, C. Raina MacIntyre, Flora D. Salim
arxiv-2505-22692.description: Abstract . Accurate forecasting of Avian Influenza Virus (AIV) outbreaks within wild bird populations necessitates models that account for complex, multi-scale transmission patterns driven by diverse factors. While conventional spatiotemporal epidemic models are robust for human-centric diseases, they rely on spatial homophily and diffusive transmission between geographic regions.

arxiv-2508-12225.title: Adaptive Control with Set-Point Tracking and Linear-like Closed-loop Behavior
arxiv-2508-12225.creator: Mohamad T. Shahab
arxiv-2508-12225.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of set-point tracking for a discrete-time plant with unknown plant parameters belonging to a convex and compact uncertainty set. We carry out parameter estimation for an associated auxiliary plant, and a pole-placement-based control law is employed.

pmc-11422176.title: Inhibition of HDAC8 mitigates AKI by reducing DNA damage and promoting homologous recombination repair
pmc-11422176.creator: Yanjin Wang, Chao Yu, Jianjun Yu, Fengchen Shen, Xinyu Du, Na Liu, Shougang Zhuang
pmc-11422176.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Nephrotoxicity is a major side effect of platinum‐based antineoplastic drugs, and there is currently no available therapeutic intervention. Our study suggests that targeting histone deacetylase 8 could be a potential treatment for cisplatin‐induced acute kidney injury (AKI). In a murine model of AKI induced by cisplatin, the administration of PCI‐34051, a selective inhibitor of HDAC8, resulted in significant improvement in renal function and reduction in renal tubular damage and apoptosis.

pmc-11597562.creator: Yan Gu, Jingyi Zhang, Haohong Zheng, Yuyang Qin, Min Zheng, Yanchun Hu, Jialiang Xin
pmc-11597562.description: : Background: Rising global temperatures have been linked to an increased incidence of heat stress (HS)-induced myocardial damage. Methods: This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic potential of shikimic acid (SA) on HS-induced myocardial damage using network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments.

pmc-12597921.title: Case Report: IgG4-related ophthalmic disease presenting with unilateral proptosis
pmc-12597921.creator: Xiaodong Li, Xuewei Qin, Mei Chen, Xi Zheng
pmc-12597921.description: IgG4-related eye disease (IgG4-ROD) is characterized by diffuse swelling or well-defined masses in the lacrimal glands, extraocular muscles, and eyelids, often accompanied by eyelid swelling, proptosis, and diplopia. It typically affects both sides symmetrically and can mimic various infectious, inflammatory, and neoplastic diseases.
